What is Cecilia for?

Cecilia helps you record your menstrual cycle and body signs and understand a daily fertility forecast. It brings daily guidance, a calendar, and temperature charts into one app.

narrative.northStar: Cecilia's cream and plum app identity
narrative.overview:
Cecilia pairs a warm cream canvas with plum actions, dark brown text, and the app's five-color cycle glyph. Rounded Nunito Sans typography and generous space give the website the same approachable character as the application. Real localized app screens supply the visual detail.

This record describes the implemented website, rather than a proposed redesign. It was extracted from `state/adapters/inbound/styles/global.css`, `state/adapters/inbound/components/`, and the six current English, Spanish, and Portuguese captures at desktop and mobile widths. The user-pinned direction in `docs/md/SURFACE.md` was the visual authority; no approved comp or quality-board comparison was available.
keyCharacteristics: Warm cream backgrounds, plum emphasis, and dark brown reading text.
One rounded sans-serif family with a clear, balanced heading hierarchy.
Open sections, restrained dividers, and spacious screenshot figures.
Real app screens and the original five-color cycle identity.
The same visual system across all three languages.

rules.name: The App Identity Rule
rules.body: Preserve the app's cream, plum, and five-color cycle identity when extending this website.

rules.name: The Quiet Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Use size, weight, spacing, and a plum phrase to establish emphasis within the single type family.

rules.name: The Open Sections Rule
rules.body: Separate explanations with space, tonal sections, and thin dividers; use contained surfaces to present the app screenshots.

rules.name: The Screen Depth Rule
rules.body: Keep elevation attached to the app imagery; use spacing and color for the surrounding page structure.

rules.name: The Native Screens Rule
rules.body: Use the real localized app screenshots, keep their aspect ratio, and keep the illustrative-data caption visible.

rules.name: The Room for Focus Rule
rules.body: Interactive elements use a plum outline (3px) offset from the element (6px). Preserve the answer clearance below an expanded question's summary so the outline does not cross the answer text. The skip link becomes visible on focus.

dos: Do retain cream as the page canvas and plum as the shared action and emphasis color.
Do use the original cycle glyph and preserve the divider's five-color order.
Do keep real screenshots localized and visibly labeled as illustrative examples.
Do let translated content wrap naturally while retaining the shared hierarchy and reading order.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus, answer clearance, and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't redraw the application interface or substitute invented product imagery for the real screenshots.
Don't use the screenshot surface tints as competing primary action colors.
Don't crop away app content or the example-data captions to force a fixed composition.
Don't turn an unused stylesheet declaration into an established design token.
